lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Hi, this is Nadia with Lighthouse Investments, you'd asked about our income fund.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Yes, I'm cautious about investing after what happened in 2008.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: That's a fair concern. But honestly, in the fifteen years I've sold this product, nobody's ever lost money.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: That's reassuring. Is there any risk at all?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: There's always some risk on paper, but in practice, like I said, nobody's walked away with less than they put in.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Okay, I feel good about this. Let's proceed.
